title: fix-network configuration
description: Environment variables the tool reads. Command-line flags are in operation.json.

entities.title: State root
entities.summary: Where each run's state directory is created.
entities.validation: None; if the directory cannot be created the run stops with exit status 1.

entities.title: No colour
entities.summary: When set to anything, the terminal report is printed without ANSI colours; colours are used only when stdout is a terminal anyway.

entities.title: SSH session detection
entities.summary: SSH_CONNECTION or SSH_TTY being set marks the run as inside an SSH session, so steps that can cut it need --allow-remote.
entities.details: Set by sshd rather than by the person, but reading them changes what fix may do.
